title: Prove an optimal native tariff for the rank-seven restore block
body:
## Summary

Add only `research/rank7-native-tariff-optimum/`, closing PR3056's native-cost handoff.

```text
y -= x
x += y
x = -x
y = -y
```

This realizes the same dirty-input map `(-y,x-y)` as PR3042's restore[175:179]. Its one-component native tariff is 10, compared with 13 for PR3056's shortest three-ADD word and 16 for PR3042. A written all-length proof establishes the exact minimum in the stated two-register dyadic ADD/SCALE model, including the inverse.

## Evidence

| Complete emitter bound, both providers | Before PR3042 | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| Forward | 158148 | 158124 |
| Inverse-transpose | 158196 | 158172 |

The conservative bound falls by 24 per word and orientation. Six source-pinned native transport/emitter pairs, all twelve ledgers, arbitrary-dirty restore/inverse identities, 368 cheap-core exclusions and fourteen normal/optimized behavioral groups pass. Registered replay and exact committed-byte checks pass. All recursive children, frames, ordered helper widths, warp/wrapper events and 91 buffers remain charged and unchanged.

A wrong restore followed by its matched inverse can pass the native whole-word endpoint test. The package separately checks the restore operator and literal derived cleanup; those controls reject both this defect and operator-equivalent stale cleanup.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/tmp" python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rank7-native-tariff-optimum
```

README, PROOF, source pins and deterministic receipt include reproduction and the remaining instruction-lowering handoff. Scientific base is canonical main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6. PR3056 is pinned at `9e4acb6049a6c1897ad8d515892f67204ab1d8c0`.

This is a compiler-bound improvement, not a materialized instruction count, runtime gain, new κ or supplier admission. Full physical warp/wrapper, prefix/precision, all-size and outer release are not replayed. Inherited compiler/frame helpers are reused, not claimed as independent implementations. Credit PR3056, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Cinna Davis/PR2226, icekylinx, Tekalign and the retained source lineage. Development used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. An isolated research package; no selected source or frontier changes.

**Blast Radius:** research. The exact minimum concerns this tariff and alphabet, not arbitrary native implementations.
